scope: analysis only; no training, no optimizer update, no SID rewrite

definitions.common_in: P(u) intersect P(v) is non-empty on the directed train graph
definitions.common_out: S(u) intersect S(v) is non-empty on the directed train graph
definitions.target_positive: the validation row's target item for the anchor u
definitions.negative: a degree-matched catalogue item not in the row's history, seen_history, anchor or target
definitions.level_1_shared_in_fidelity: within-arm Spearman between hard-SID distance and directed J_in on a fixed pair population
definitions.level_2_cross_arm: across the eight arms, Pearson/Spearman between a level-1 score and Stage3 test_R@10

hypotheses.statement: Shared-in neighbours are substitute next-purchase candidates: target items are more likely than degree-matched negatives to share an in-neighbour with the anchor, and the effect is not exhausted by popularity or degree.
supported_if: target common-in rate exceeds the degree-matched negative rate with a positive paired difference
the direction survives within directed total-degree and popularity strata
a positive common-in effect remains after conditioning on SID prefix sharing
falsified_if: target and negative rates are indistinguishable or reversed
the apparent effect vanishes after degree/popularity matching
the effect is only a relabelling of shared prefixes

hypotheses.statement: The historical shared-in/test-R@10 association is substantially driven by semantic/prefix structure, degree or popularity; it is not a pure graph-topology effect.
supported_if: the directed shared-in association with test_R@10 is weak or unstable once prefix/degree controls are reported
the eight-arm association depends on one architecture/capacity group or is not reproduced by the recomputed directed label
falsified_if: a stable directed shared-in association remains in the within-arm and cross-arm views after explicit controls
the association is reproduced with the correct directed pair label and is not driven by a single arm

hypotheses.statement: Curvature fidelity, reconstruction and quantisation are architecture/capacity proxies rather than independent causes of recommendation quality.
supported_if: the eight-arm correlation is carried by the five-expert or role-conditioned group
the new predicted/target or per-level diagnostics do not preserve an independent association after leave-one-out and group inspection
falsified_if: a curvature/reconstruction diagnostic is stable across architectures and sensitivity variants and has a same-generation identity-bound interpretation

statistics.multiplicity: descriptive only; no adjusted discovery claim
statistics.missing: NA with attempted path; never 0 or imputed
